# AIOS Recommendation Principle

An AI recommendation is not merely advice.

It is an evidence-based business proposal.

Every recommendation should:

Explain.

Justify.

Predict.

Recommend.

Measure.

Learn.

The executive should always understand:

Why this recommendation exists.

Why AI believes it is the best option.

What outcome is expected.

What risks remain.
